name: Dexco S.A.
summary: Dexco S.A., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells wooden panels in Brazil and internationally. It operates through Wood Panels; Metals and Sanitary Ware; Coatings; and Soluble Pulp segments. The company offers medium density particulate panels, and medium and high-density fiberboard panels under the Duratex brand; and laminated floors and semifinished components for furniture under the Durafloor brand name. It also provides ceramic and cement flooring, as well as coatings under the Ceusa, Portinari, and Castelatto brands.
